subject: Evaluate lean-crush as a reconstruction-only MC1 proof producer

upstream.note: The manifest declares no dependencies, so the adapter has no Mathlib, solver-library or vendored Lean closure to reconcile.

adapter.kind: one-line source patch of an upstream module, built with Noble's pinned Lean release
adapter.rationale: Lean 4.31 has no `ite_eq_right`; `if_neg` states the same step for a propositional condition.
adapter.untouched: No axiom, no toolchain file, no lakefile option, no solver default and no trust default is changed.

sandbox.note: Used only for the consumer runs; the producer-side probes ran unsandboxed as untrusted producers do.
